decisions.reason: As the flagship of the firm's organic push with several variants close to its core salami competence, the platter is more likely to be refined than withdrawn.
The premium sharing salami line uses the firm's curing strengths and serves the growing snacking segment, though snack formats are more exposed to listing churn at retailers.
Organic Fleischwurst is a staple German product newly added to the organic team and needs more than one year to prove itself on the shelf.

The thinly sliced organic chicken breast line in two flavors fits the demand for lighter, ingredient-conscious poultry, although the earlier withdrawal of the poultry snack shows poultry carries some risk.
The herb-coated organic salami builds directly on core curing know-how, is presented on its own page and was only recently launched, so the firm will give it time.
